resources.string: Shows a small Flo bubble on the edge of the screen when you tap a text field. Tap it to dictate, or hold it to ask Flo (you can change this in Flo, Settings, Voice bubble). Dictation works without internet using your phone\'s on-device speech recognition. Drag the bubble anywhere, or onto Hide to put it away. Flo only reads the field you are typing in, never passwords, and only listens while you talk to it.
